codes.message: {os}/{arch} is not a supported platform.
codes.hint: Use a supported platform (macOS, Linux or Windows on x64/arm64) or install from source.

codes.message: Cannot write to the platform directory {path}.
codes.hint: Choose another directory with --platform-root or fix its permissions.

codes.message: Not enough disk space in {path}: {needed} needed, {available} available.
codes.hint: Free up disk space or choose another directory with --platform-root.

codes.message: Cannot reach the release index or registry at {url}.
codes.hint: Check your network or proxy settings and retry.

codes.message: The release index is corrupted or its signature does not match.
codes.hint: Retry the command; if it persists report the correlationId (this is a KB Labs problem).

codes.message: The release index uses schema {schema}, which this launcher does not support.
codes.hint: Update the launcher (kb-create update, or download the current launcher) and retry.

codes.message: Platform {platform} requires launcher {minLauncherVersion} or newer, but this is {launcher}.
codes.hint: Run kb-create update, or download the current launcher, then retry.

codes.message: Required Node.js or package manager version is missing: {requirement}.
codes.hint: Install the required version or use the bundled runtime.

codes.message: Runtime preflight failed: the installed toolchain is not supported.
codes.hint: Use Node.js 24.x and pnpm 11.x, or update the runtime and retry.

codes.message: The requested operation is not supported.
codes.hint: Use plan, apply, update, uninstall, rollback, doctor, wizard or status.

codes.message: Selected components are incompatible: {reason}.
codes.hint: Choose compatible versions or a different release channel.

codes.message: No adapter provides the required capability {capability}.
codes.hint: Select a provider explicitly with --provider.

codes.message: Capability {capability} has more than one compatible provider.
codes.hint: Specify which provider to use with --provider.

codes.message: Required input is missing: {field}.
codes.hint: Supply the missing input as a flag, in the request JSON, or through the wizard.

codes.message: Required configuration is missing or conflicting: {field}.
codes.hint: Provide the configuration value or run the wizard to complete it.

codes.message: The scenario could not be compiled.
codes.hint: Inspect the scenario answers and the manifest requirements.

codes.message: A wizard answer is invalid.
codes.hint: Choose one of the displayed compatible options.

codes.message: A secret input could not be stored.
codes.hint: Pass --secret-env requirement=ENV_VAR and set the environment variable.

codes.message: The artifact manifest does not match the installed artifact {artifact}.
codes.hint: Retry the installation; if it persists report the correlationId.

codes.message: The rendered service graph does not match the resolved plan or the running services.
codes.hint: Run "kb-create doctor --fix" to rebuild generated files from the install receipt.

codes.message: The operation did not reach a verified installation.
codes.hint: Inspect the local log and the diagnostic dossier, fix the reported prerequisite, or run "kb-create doctor --fix".

codes.message: The operation failed.
codes.hint: Inspect the local log and include the correlationId in a report.

codes.message: The recovery operation did not reach a verified state.
codes.hint: Inspect the local log and the diagnostic dossier, then retry with the named receipt or snapshot.

codes.message: The active install receipt could not be read.
codes.hint: Run apply first or restore a named snapshot.

codes.message: The installed service graph is not ready.
codes.hint: Inspect "kb-dev status" or run "kb-create doctor --fix".

codes.message: Installed manifest diagnostics could not be prepared.
codes.hint: Install exact artifacts that ship matching manifests.

codes.message: The local operation log could not be created.
codes.hint: Check that the platform root is writable.

codes.message: The operation failed and the diagnostic dossier could not be written.
codes.hint: Inspect the local operation log.

codes.message: The installation was interrupted.
codes.hint: Run "kb-create apply" again; it resumes from where it stopped.

codes.message: The rollback did not succeed; the snapshot is at {snapshot}.
codes.hint: Restore the snapshot manually and report the correlationId.

codes.message: The KB Labs host is not running: cannot connect to {address}.
codes.hint: Run "kb-create start", or "kb-create doctor" if the host should already be running.

codes.message: The KB Labs host is already running.
codes.hint: Use "kb-create status" or "kb-create restart".

codes.message: Port {port} is used by another application.
codes.hint: Stop the application that uses the port, or change the host port in the installation config, then run "kb-create start" again.

codes.message: The host process failed while starting.
codes.hint: Read the reason in the log and report the correlationId if it is unclear.

codes.message: The host responds but module {module} is unhealthy.
codes.hint: Run "kb-create restart" or "kb-create doctor".

codes.message: Refusing to expose the host without authentication on a non-loopback address.
codes.hint: Enable authentication or bind to a loopback address.

codes.message: The launcher or CLI version {client} does not match the host version {host}.
codes.hint: Run "kb-create update".

codes.message: The launcher control channel is unavailable.
codes.hint: Start the launcher or the desktop shell.

codes.message: Cannot write to the state directory {path}.
codes.hint: Fix the directory permissions or free disk space.

codes.message: The host process {pid} did not stop.
codes.hint: Run "kb-create stop" again, or end the process manually and remove the stale pid file.

codes.message: The host specification in the installation receipt is invalid: {reason}.
codes.hint: Run "kb-create doctor --fix" or reinstall with "kb-create apply".

codes.message: The launcher control channel rejected the request token.
codes.hint: Read the current token from control.json in the launcher state directory.

codes.message: Adapter {slot} is unavailable: {reason}.
codes.hint: Start or configure the adapter under adapters.{slot} in kb.config.json.

codes.message: Authentication is required.
codes.hint: Run "kb auth login".

codes.message: The credentials are invalid.
codes.hint: Retry, or reset your credentials.

codes.message: Your session token has expired and could not be refreshed.
codes.hint: Run "kb auth login".

codes.message: You do not have permission to perform this operation (required role: {role}).
codes.hint: Ask your administrator to grant the required role.

codes.message: No administrator access is available.
codes.hint: Run "kb-create doctor --recover".

codes.message: The gateway is unreachable.
codes.hint: Check that the host is running, see KB_HOST_UNREACHABLE.

codes.message: The token time does not match the system clock.
codes.hint: Check the system time and time zone.

codes.message: The client expects authentication mode {expected} but the host runs in {actual}.
codes.hint: Align the client with the installed access mode.

codes.message: The project path {path} does not exist.
codes.hint: Check the path and run "kb project add <path>" again.

codes.message: The project path {path} is not a directory.
codes.hint: Pass the project folder, not a file.

codes.message: No permission to read the project path {path}.
codes.hint: Fix the folder permissions or pick another folder.

codes.message: The project {path} is already registered.
codes.hint: Use "kb project show" to inspect it.

codes.message: The project {path} is not in the registry (the folder may have moved).
codes.hint: Register it with "kb project add {path}".

codes.message: The .kb configuration of the project is invalid at {field}: {expected}.
codes.hint: Fix {field} in the project .kb configuration.

codes.message: The runtime of project {project} did not start.
codes.hint: Read the reason in the log and include the correlationId if you report it.

codes.message: The limit of {limit} active project runtimes is reached.
codes.hint: Close an inactive project and try again.

codes.message: The project name {name} is already used by another registered project.
codes.hint: Pick another name with --name, or run "kb project list" to see the registered names.

codes.message: The project registry {file} is unreadable: {reason}.
codes.hint: Inspect or move {file} aside, then register your projects again with "kb project add <path>"; the file is never overwritten automatically.

codes.message: The project registry {file} uses schema version {found}, but this KB Labs build supports version {supported}.
codes.hint: Update KB Labs to a build that supports the registry schema; the file is left untouched.

codes.message: The project registry is locked by another KB Labs process (waited {timeoutMs} ms).
codes.hint: Retry in a moment; if no other kb command is running, remove the stale projects.json.lock file next to the registry.

codes.message: Unknown configuration key {path}.
codes.hint: {suggestion} Run "kb config show" to list the keys that are set.

codes.message: The configuration references {variable}, which has no value.
codes.hint: Set the environment variable or store the secret, then retry.

codes.message: Refusing to store a plain secret at {path}.
codes.hint: Put the secret in an environment variable and store a reference: {example}. Use --allow-plain-secret only for throwaway local values.

codes.message: The configuration file {path} was changed by another writer.
codes.hint: Reload the file and repeat the change.

codes.message: The LLM provider {provider} rejected the API key.
codes.hint: Replace the key under the LLM settings in kb.config.json.

codes.message: The quota or budget for LLM provider {provider} is exhausted.
codes.hint: Top up the quota or switch to another model.

codes.message: Plugin {plugin} needs SDK {required} but {installed} is installed.
codes.hint: Update the plugin or the platform to compatible versions.

codes.message: The namespace {namespace} is reserved.
codes.hint: Choose another namespace, for example acme-{namespace}.

codes.message: The namespace {namespace} is taken by package {owner}.
codes.hint: Choose another namespace or use the owning package.

codes.message: Command {command} is hidden: plugin {plugin} is shadowed by a built-in command.
codes.hint: Run "kb plugin doctor" for details.

codes.message: Installing plugin {plugin} failed.
codes.hint: Check the network and registry, then retry.

codes.message: Plugin {plugin} could not be loaded.
codes.hint: Run "kb plugin doctor" to see the manifest or dependency problem.

codes.message: Plugin {plugin} crashed while running.
codes.hint: Retry; if it repeats, include the correlationId in a report.

codes.message: Plugin {plugin} did not finish in time.
codes.hint: Retry or increase the timeout.

codes.message: Plugin {plugin} was denied the {permission} permission.
codes.hint: Grant the permission in the plugin settings if you trust it.

codes.message: Downloading the update failed.
codes.hint: Check the network and run the update again.

codes.message: The update is incompatible with the installed components: {reason}.
codes.hint: Resolve the blocking component first, then update.

codes.message: Verification after the update failed; rolled back to {version}.
codes.hint: Inspect the diagnostic dossier and report the correlationId.

codes.message: The host did not become healthy after the update.
codes.hint: Wait for the automatic rollback or run "kb-create rollback".

codes.message: There is no snapshot to roll back to.
codes.hint: Reinstall the previous version with "kb-create apply".

codes.message: The operation did not finish in time.
codes.hint: Retry or increase the timeout.

codes.message: There is no free disk space in {path}.
codes.hint: Free some space or clear the cache and logs there.

codes.message: The log storage is unavailable.
codes.hint: Try "kb logs query" first, then the raw log files under .kb/logs.

codes.message: The request limit was reached; retry after {retryAfter}.
codes.hint: Wait and retry, or reduce the request rate.

codes.message: Configuration value {path} is invalid.
codes.hint: Provide a valid value for {path} (see the cause) and retry; "kb config get {path}" shows the current one.

codes.message: Plugin {plugin} was not found in the registry.
codes.hint: Check the exact name with "kb marketplace search".

codes.message: Service {service} is not configured.
codes.hint: Add {adapter} under adapters in kb.config.json.

codes.message: The provided input is invalid.
codes.hint: Correct the reported fields and retry; run the command with --help for the expected input.

codes.message: An unexpected error occurred.
codes.hint: Re-run with --debug and include the correlationId in a report.
